name: fhferreira/llms-txt
description: Generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt for routes tagged with the `llms` middleware. Laravel package designed to make APIs LLM-consumable per the llmstxt.org spec.

suggest.mcp/sdk: Required to run the dynamic MCP server backed by llms-mcp.json (stdio command + HTTP controller).
suggest.symfony/psr-http-message-bridge: Required when mounting the HTTP MCP controller, so Laravel Request ↔ PSR-7 conversion works.
suggest.nyholm/psr7: Concrete PSR-7/PSR-17 implementation used by the HTTP MCP controller for request/response factories.
